senses.gloss:
f. (-का)
Sixtieth part of a Gharī, equal to 24 seconds.
E.
वि, and घटिका a Gharī.

m. (-नः)
A mallet, a hammer, an implement for striking.
E.
वि before हन to strike, अप् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Rubbing, friction.
2 Striking.
3 Opening, undoing, untying.
4 Offending.
E.
वि, घटृ to rub, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Rubbed, touched.
2 Offended.
3 Struck.
4 Untied, undone.
E.
वि before घट्ट or rub, aff. क्त.

m. (-सः)
1 The residue of food offered to the gods, to the manes, to a venerable guest, or a spiritual preceptor.
2 Food in general.
E.
वि before अद to eat, aff. अप्, and घस substituted for the root.

m. (-शः)
One who eats the remains of an offering.
E.
विघस, and आश eating; also विघसाशिन्, &c.

mn. (-तः-तं)
1 Impediment, obstacle.
2 Prohibition or prevention.
3 Opposition.
4 Destruction.
5 A blow.
E.
वि before हन to kill or hurt, aff. क्त.

f. (-द्धिः)
Removing obstacles or impediments.
E.
विघात, and सिद्धि attainment.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
1 Opposing, impeding, preventing.
2 Removing, destroying.
3 Wounding, killing.
E.
वि before हन to hurt or strike, aff. णिनि.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Cried, proclaimed.
E.
वि before घुष्ट cried.

ind.
Having proclaimed.
E.
वि before घुष to cry, ल्यप् aff.

n. (-णं)
Proclamation, crying.
E.
वि before घुष to cry aloud, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-घ्नः)
1 Obstacle, impediment.
2 The Caronda, (Carissa Carondas.)
E.
वि before हन to be injured (by it), and क aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Opposing, impeding, obstructing.
E.
विघ्न, and कर what makes.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Impeding, obstructing.
2 Fearful, formidable, terrible.
E.
विघ्न an obstacle, and कारिन् causing.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what removes difficulties, &c.
m. (-कः)
A name of GAṆEŚA.
E.
विघ्न, and नाशक who or what destroys.

n. (-नं)
Removing obstacles.
m. (-नः)
A name of GAṆEŚA.
E.
विघ्न an obstacle, and नाशन removing; the deity being supposed capable of either causing or removing difficulties and impediments, and being therefore especially worshipped at the commencement of any undertaking: also other similar compounds.

m. (-जः)
GAṆEŚA.
E.
विघ्न an impediment, and राज ruler: see the last.

m. (-शः)
Slight obstacle or impediment.
E.
विघ्न an obstacle, and लेश a little.

m. (-कः)
GAṆEŚA.
E.
विघ्न an obstacle, and विनायक remover.

f. (-द्धिः)
Removal of obstacles.
E.
विघ्न, and सिद्धि accomplishment.

m. (-री)
GAṆEŚA.
E.
विघ्न an obstacle, हारिन् who removes see विघ्ननाशन.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Stopped, prevented, obstructed, impeded.
E.
विघ्न an obstacle, इतच् aff.

m. (-शः)
GAṆEŚA.
E.
विघ्न an obstacle, and ईश lord: see विघ्ननाशन.
